1. Decision Flow

Step 1 → Hard gates: SPY crash, VIX capitulation, breadth collapse → REJECT
Step 2 → Regime check: set score/RR/RS thresholds from regime4 or legacy 3-regime
Step 3 → Score check: total_score vs regime threshold → AVOID if below
Step 4 → Entry quality: EXTENDED/MISSED → WATCH
Step 5 → R:R + RS + weekly + catalyst checks → BUY / WATCH / AVOID

Post-decision overrides:
  - Gate failure → force AVOID
  - MTF conflict (daily bull + weekly bear) → cap BUY → WATCH
  - Adaptive engine → p90-relative promote WATCH → BUY
  - Entry-zone check → price in pullback zone → WATCH → BUY

ALL must pass. Any failure → AVOID.

#GateDefault

S2VIX ≥ short_min_vix25
S3Bear/risk-off regime requiredMust be weak_regime
S4RSI ≥ short_min_rsi (not oversold)70 (distribution zone)
S5RS rank ≤ short_max_rs30 (only short weak stocks)

S7Sector underperforming SPYDon't short into leading sector
S8Short float ≤ 15%High SI = squeeze trap
S9Days-to-cover ≤ 5DTC > 5 = concentrated shorts
S10No active TTM SqueezeExpansion direction unknown

SHORT verdict: bear_score ≥ 12/15 AND weak_regime AND R:R ≥ 3:1

Near-Short (blocked): bear_score ≥ 4 but gates failed → shown separately in Slack + dashboard

9. Adaptive Engine

Active when profile has adaptive_mode: true. Runs in Step 5d after scoring, before pick selection.

Pass 1: p90-Relative Threshold

adaptive_buy_min = max(p90 - 8, floor=40)

If today's p90=49, buy_min drops from 60 → 41. Promotes WATCH → BUY when score ≥ adaptive bar AND RS ≥ rs_min AND R:R ≥ rr_min.

Guards: only promote when state data has valid zones (not default LOST_STRUCTURE from missing data). RVOL ≥ 0.3 (regular-session volume).

Pass 2: Setup Bonuses in Choppy Regime

Setup familyBonus
EMA21/EMA50 Pullback, Bounce, Trend Continuation, 10-Week Pullback+5 pts
52wk Breakout, VCP Breakout-3 pts (breakouts fail in chop)

Pass 3: Top-N Fallback

If fewer than adaptive_top_n (default 5) BUYs after passes 1+2, take the top WATCH tickers by score (floor=40, R:R passes) to guarantee minimum signal volume.

EdgeVALID, NONEIs there an actionable entry?
ActionBUY, WATCH, WAIT_FOR_PULLBACK, AVOIDWhat to do right now

BUY only when: location = AT_VALUE + confirmation score ≥ 2 + score ≥ buy_min + R:R ≥ rr_min

11. Entry Zone + Structural Stops

Entry Zone

Ceiling: EMA21 (buy at or below)
Floor: max(support, VP-VAL) — structural support from volume profile value area low
Entry: midpoint of zone

Auto-promote (Step 5f): if WATCH ticker's current price is within entry_low – entry_high AND R:R ≥ 2.0 → promote to BUY with reason "Pullback entry".

Structural Stop-Loss

stop = min(prior_swing_low_5bar, VP_VAL, EMA50) - 0.5 × ATR

Uses actual price structure instead of generic ATR multiple. 0.5 ATR buffer below structure for noise protection.

12. Options Intelligence (Stock-Trading Signals)

From Schwab /chains. NOT for trading options — for reading options market to improve stock decisions.

SignalBullishBearishAction for stock trade
IV Percentile< 30%> 70%High IV: tighter stop, smaller size. Low IV: full size.
Put/Call Ratio< 0.5> 1.5Low P/C: institutions bullish. High P/C: hedging/bearish.
UOA CallsVol/OI > 3×—Strongest bullish confirmation. Upgrade size.
UOA Puts—Vol/OI > 3×Warning: informed bearish bet. Reduce size or skip.
Max PainPrice below MPPrice above MPPrice gravitates toward MP near expiry. Set targets near it.
Gammaγ+ (stabilizing)γ- (volatile)Positive: shallow pullbacks. Negative: widen stops.

13. Volume Profile

LevelWhat it isHow to use
POC (Point of Control)Price with highest traded volumeFair-value magnet. Support if above, resistance if below.
VAH (Value Area High)Upper bound of 70% volume zoneBreakout above VAH on volume = expansion signal.
VAL (Value Area Low)Lower bound of 70% volume zoneUsed as structural stop-loss floor.
LVN (Low Volume Node)Price gap with < 20% avg volumePrice moves FAST through LVN gaps. Breakout targets.

14. Sector Rotation Bonus

Sectors outperforming SPY by > 2% get +3 score pts for all tickers within that sector. Follows institutional capital flow — leading sectors have tailwinds that improve pullback entry win rates.
